review_candidates.title: Staff Enterprise Engineer (Storage)
review_candidates.job_function: Engineering
review_candidates.description: LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed. Join us to transform the way the world works. Job Description At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. About the role LinkedIn is seeking a Staff Enterprise Engineer specializing in storage and backup solutions with a robust background in automation to contribute to our mission of revolutionizing data protection and storage architectures. In this capacity, you will oversee the architectural design, operational management, and reliability of enterprise-scale storage and backup systems across hybrid environments, including Microsoft Azure. This role requires technical leadership to drive operational excellence through automation and strategic engineering improvements. You will lead critical infrastructure programs and act as a primary technical escalation point for resolving performance and reliability issues to ensure the availability of our global services. Responsibilities Administer, maintain, and optimize enterprise storage and backup platforms across on-premises and cloud environments. Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for storage, backup, recovery, and performance-related incidents. Plan and execute infrastructure deployments, upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh initiatives. Develop automation and operational tooling using Python and PowerShell to improve efficiency, consistency, and reliability. Implement and maintain monitoring, reporting, capacity planning, and performance management processes. Design and support high availability, disaster recovery, replication, and data protection solutions. Collaborate with cloud, virtualization, network, security, and application teams on infrastructure projects and operational initiatives. Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and architectural standards. Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior engineers. Participate in a global on-call rotation and support critical production incidents. Qualifications Basic Qualifications 8+ years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise storage, backup, or infrastructure platforms. Experience with enterprise storage and data protection technologies in production environments. Experience with Microsoft Azure infrastructure services. Proficiency in automation and scripting using Python and PowerShell. Experience supporting business-critical production environments and participating in on-call rotations. Experience with troubleshooting, incident management, and root cause analysis. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Pure Storage, NetApp, Nasuni, Rubrik, Azure Backup, or similar enterprise platforms. Understanding of SAN, NAS, object storage, snapshots, replication, disaster recovery, and data lifecycle management. Knowledge of Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, SMB/CIFS, zoning, and multipathing. Experience supporting VMware, Hyper-V, or other virtualization platforms. Familiarity with infrastructure automation and configuration management tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Git, and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with capacity planning, performance optimization, operational reporting, and infrastructure monitoring. Experience leading cross-functional technical investigations and infrastructure initiatives. Suggested Skills Storage systems administration Backup and recovery operations Python and PowerShell scripting Azure infrastructure services Incident and problem management Additional Information India Disability Policy LinkedIn is an equal employment opportunity employer offering opportunities to all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. For more information on our equal opportunity policy, please visit https://legal.linkedin.com/content/dam/legal/Policy_India_EqualOppPWD_9-12-2023.pdf Global Data Privacy Notice and Compliance Posters for Job Candidates Please use this link to access documents that provide information about how LinkedIn handles the personal data of employees and job applicants, as well as the E-Verify Participation Notice and the Department of Justice Immigrant and Employee Rights Section Right to Work posters: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/candidate-portal.

review_candidates.title: IT Manager – Technology Operations & Integration
review_candidates.description: 🚨 We're Hiring | IT Manager – Technology Operations & Integration 📍 Location: Remote – India 🕐 Shift: US Working Hours 💼 Experience: 8–12+ years Numera is looking for a hands-on IT Manager – Technology Operations & Integration to manage our IT operations, applications, infrastructure, security, and technology integration initiatives. We are particularly looking for someone with strong experience in Google Workspace administration, Microsoft-to-Google Workspace migrations, and accounting/tax applications . 🔑 Key Responsibilities • Own day-to-day IT operations, infrastructure, applications, devices, endpoints, and IT assets • Administer Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, cloud/SaaS applications, and IAM • Manage onboarding/offboarding, user accounts, access, permissions, hardware and software provisioning • Lead or coordinate email, collaboration, application, data and technology migrations • Support technology integration of newly acquired businesses • Assess infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, IAM, SaaS and technology environments • Develop and execute technology integration and migration plans • Manage endpoint security, authentication, access controls and IT security policies • Manage IT vendors, licensing, renewals and technology partnerships • Work closely with U.S.-based leadership and distributed teams ⭐ Key Experience We're Looking For Google Workspace Hands-on Google Workspace / Google Workspace Admin experience Google Admin Console, user and access administration Experience migrating from Microsoft 365 / Microsoft environment to Google Workspace Experience with Gmail, Google Drive, Shared Drives, Groups, security and user migration Accounting & Tax Applications Hands-on experience setting up, configuring, migrating or administering applications such as: QuickBooks / QuickBooks Online Zoho Books Xero Drake Tax Lacerte Experience supporting CPA firms, accounting firms, tax organizations or financial services environments would be an advantage. IT Operations & Technology IT Infrastructure & Operations Cloud & SaaS platforms IAM / Identity Management Endpoint Management Cybersecurity Networking Data & Application Migration IT Asset Management Vendor & Project Management 🔹 Additional Advantage Experience with M&A, acquisitions, post-merger integration, or technology integration is highly preferred, particularly where you have personally supported the migration or integration of users, email, applications, devices, infrastructure, security and data. If you are an experienced IT professional who enjoys being hands-on, solving technology problems, managing applications and leading migrations/integrations , we'd love to hear from you. 📩 Interested candidates can apply or DM me with their updated resume. #Hiring #ITManager #GoogleWorkspace #GoogleWorkspaceAdmin #QuickBooks #ZohoBooks #Xero #DrakeTax #Lacerte #ITOperations #ITInfrastructure #TechnologyIntegration #ITMigration #RemoteJobs #IndiaJobs

review_candidates.title: Network Field Engineer
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.job_function: Sales and Business Development
review_candidates.description: Company Description KGiSL is a BFSI-centric enterprise software company specializing in Insurance, Capital Markets, and Wealth Management solutions. The organization focuses on delivering measurable business outcomes by combining deep domain expertise with empathy-driven customer engagement. KGiSL leverages Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Analytics, Data Science, and Cloud technologies to provide next-generation customer experiences for leading financial institutions across the APAC region and beyond. Trusted by major insurance and financial brands, the company is recognized for its comprehensive product portfolio and commitment to client success. With over 1,700 professionals and offices in India, USA, Singapore, Malaysia, UAE, and Thailand, KGiSL promotes continuous learning and upskilling to drive innovative, real-time solutions. Role Description The Network Field Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Abu Dhabi, responsible for supporting and maintaining network infrastructure at client locations. This role involves installing, configuring, and monitoring network equipment, including switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless solutions, to ensure stable and secure connectivity. The Network Field Engineer conducts regular performance checks, diagnoses and resolves network incidents, and provides hands-on technical support for end users and on-site teams. The position includes collaborating with internal and client stakeholders to implement network changes, document configurations, and support upgrades and migrations in line with security and compliance requirements. The engineer will also participate in preventive maintenance activities and contribute to continuous improvement of network operations and standards. Key Responsibilities: · Design, implement, and maintain network infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance and security. · Monitor and troubleshoot network systems, including LAN/WAN, routers, switches, firewalls, and VPNs. · Perform network configuration and upgrades in line with company requirements and industry best practices. · Respond to network issues and outages, providing efficient solutions in a timely manner. · Collaborate with other IT teams to deploy network solutions for various projects. · Assist in planning network capacity, ensuring scalability and redundancy for future growth. · Provide network documentation, including topology, IP addresses, and detailed configuration. · Maintain and optimize existing network systems, recommending and implementing improvements. · Conduct regular system checks and performance evaluations. · Stay updated with emerging networking technologies and industry trends to recommend improvements. · Travel to client sites for network installations, troubleshooting, and support activities (travel required within UAE). · Must have valid driving license for travel to client locations. Qualifications: · 2-3 years of hands-on experience as a Network Engineer or in a similar role. · Strong knowledge of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, etc.), and experience with network devices (routers, switches, firewalls). · Familiarity with network monitoring tools and techniques. · Experience with network configuration and troubleshooting. · Understanding of network security principles and best practices. · CCNA, CompTIA Network+, or other relevant certifications preferred. · Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. · Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. · Excellent communication skills and the ability to interact with cross-functional teams. · Must have own car and valid driving license for travel to client sites. Industry Software Development Employment Type Full-time

review_candidates.title: Principal DevOps Engineer (Azure)
review_candidates.job_function: Information Technology and Engineering
review_candidates.description: Role: Principal DevOps Engineer (Azure) Location: Nottingham (Hybrid) Salary: £75,000 – £85,000 + bonus Key Skills: Azure (Azure Landing Zones) AKS GitOps (ArgoCD) Terraform The Role: This is a hands-on senior engineering position with plenty of scope to influence technical direction, improve engineering standards and help shape the way cloud infrastructure is designed and delivered. You'll work closely with development, infrastructure and security teams, acting as a technical escalation point and helping drive best practice across the wider engineering function. What You'll Be Doing Design, build and maintain scalable Azure infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code . Develop and manage production Kubernetes/AKS environments , including upgrades, security, networking and optimisation. Establish and improve GitOps and CI/CD practices , using tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and ArgoCD. Build reusable Terraform modules, deployment templates and automation to improve consistency across environments. Design and maintain Azure networking, including VNets, hub-and-spoke architectures, DNS, NSGs and firewall solutions. Implement cloud security practices across identity, access management, container security and infrastructure. Develop and maintain Helm charts and standardised deployment processes for application teams. Introduce and improve monitoring, logging, tracing and platform observability. Automate repetitive processes using Python, Bash or similar scripting languages . Contribute to technical designs, architecture decisions and platform roadmaps. Help improve developer experience through tooling, documentation and self-service capabilities. Act as a senior technical escalation point and provide mentoring and guidance to other engineers. Support the continued evolution of the platform, including container orchestration, autoscaling, progressive delivery and platform security. What We're Looking For: You'll be an experienced DevOps/Platform Engineer with a strong background in cloud infrastructure and automation. We're looking for someone who can operate independently, get hands-on with complex technical challenges and confidently contribute to architectural discussions. Key experience: Strong commercial experience with Microsoft Azure . Extensive experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code . Strong production experience with Kubernetes, ideally AKS . Good understanding of Azure networking and cloud architecture . Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines . Experience with GitOps , ideally using ArgoCD or a similar platform. Strong knowledge of Docker and containerised environments . Experience with Helm and Kubernetes application deployment. Good understanding of cloud security, IAM, RBAC and secure CI/CD practices. Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills. Proficiency with Python, Bash or similar scripting languages . Experience contributing to technical architecture, design documentation and engineering standards. Comfortable communicating technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience mentoring engineers or acting as a senior technical point of contact. Desirable Experience Istio or Cilium Argo Rollouts KEDA or Karpenter Falco or Kyverno Go development Azure Front Door Azure Firewall Entra ID and PIM Observability platforms such as Grafana, Loki or OpenTelemetry Experience working within regulated or compliance-focused environments

review_candidates.title: Information Technology Support Specialist
review_candidates.job_function: Information Technology
review_candidates.description: Overview Please note: This position requires you to work from our Mumbai office based in Andheri East . At CACTUS, we are seeking an experienced Desktop Engineer / IT Support Analyst to provide Level 2 end-user support in a 24x7 enterprise environment. The ideal candidate will be responsible for desktop, laptop, and end-user application support , ensuring high availability, performance, and user satisfaction while meeting SLA commitments. Responsibilities Install, configure, and support Windows desktop/laptop environments (MacOS/Linux exposure is a plus). Provide L2 technical support to end-users via phone, email, chat, and remote tools. Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, Office 365, Outlook/Exchange, Active Directory, printer, and basic network issues. Manage incident and service request lifecycle using ITSM/ticketing tools, ensuring SLA adherence. Perform remote troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and coordinate escalations to internal SMEs or external vendors. Support laptop imaging, deployment, configuration, and asset management activities. Maintain and update technical documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles. Ensure compliance with IT security policies, patching, antivirus, and endpoint protection standards. Communicate effectively with users, providing timely updates and resolution status. Prepare incident reports, trend analysis, and operational documentation as required. Qualifications And Prerequisites Must Have Skills: Bachelor’s degree in B.Sc., BCA, B.Tech, BE, or equivalent experience. 3–5 years of experience in Desktop Support / IT Support Analyst / Helpdesk role. Strong hands-on experience with Windows OS, Office 365, Exchange Online, Active Directory, Skype/Teams, OneDrive. Experience in hardware troubleshooting, laptop configuration, and peripheral support. Familiarity with remote support tools and enterprise ticketing systems. Excellent problem-solving, communication, and customer-handling skills. Willingness to work in a 24x7 support environment. Preferred Skills: Exposure to Linux environments Knowledge of Active Directory user/group/DL management. Experience with ITIL-based processes; ITIL/Microsoft certifications are a plus. Familiarity with endpoint security and patch management tools. Application Process Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and an HR Business Partner round. Equal Opportunity Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic. Accelerating from Anywhere As a remote-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates. Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently. Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page. Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration. Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status. About CACTUS Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

review_candidates.description: 직무 Summary 넥스트증권의 전사 보안 체계를 기획부터 도입, 운영까지 End-to-End로 책임질 Security Engineer를 찾습니다. 엔드포인트·네트워크·서버/DB·클라우드 전 영역에 걸쳐 보안 솔루션의 요구사항을 정의하고, PoC/기술검증을 통해 최적의 솔루션을 도입하며, 도입 이후에는 정책 수립과 운영 자동화, 위협 탐지까지 책임지는 역할입니다. [주요 업무책임] 보안솔루션 기획 : 엔드포인트(DLP, DRM, 백신), 네트워크(방화벽, NAC, VPN), PAM, ZTNA, 클라우드 보안 등 전사 보안 솔루션에 대한 요구사항 분석 및 도입 전략 수립 솔루션 검토 및 도입 : 후보 솔루션에 대한 기술검증(PoC)·비교평가, 벤더 협상 지원, 아키텍처 설계 및 구축 운영 체계 설계 : 도입한 솔루션의 운영 프로세스·정책을 IAM, 원격접속 등 인접 영역과 유기적으로 연계해 설계, 비인가 접근·솔루션 우회 상시 점검·차단 운영 자동화 및 위협 탐지 고도화 : 반복적인 보안 운영 업무의 스크립트·API 기반 자동화 등 로그 분석 시스템과 AI 기반 분석 도구를 활용한 위협 탐지 정책 개발 유관부서 협업 : DevOps, 네트워크, CERT, 컴플라이언스 등 유관 부서와 협업하여 보안 아키텍처를 실행하고 정책을 시행, 실시간 탐지·대응 체계 고도화 [필수 자격요건] 보안솔루션(엔드포인트, 네트워크, 클라우드 등)의 기획·도입(PoC 포함)·운영 경험 5년 이상 제로 트러스트(ZTNA), PAM, 공급망 보안 등 최신 보안 솔루션의 기획·도입 경험 보안 아키텍처 설계 또는 보안 체계 수립 프로젝트를 리딩하거나 참여한 경험 보안 운영 업무를 스크립트(Python, Shell 등) 또는 API로 자동화해 본 경험 [선호 자격요건] 네트워크 보안(FW, NGFW, NAC, SSL VPN 등)에 대한 구조적 이해 클라우드(AWS 등) 보안 아키텍처 설계 및 운영에 대한 실무적 지식 보안 인증(ISMS, ISO27001 등) 대응 경험 AI 기반 보안 분석 도구 또는 MCP 등 자동화 프레임워크의 보안 운영 적용 경험 정보보호/보안 관련 자격증(CISA, CISSP, CPPG 등) [제출 서류 (필수)] 국문 이력서 및 자기소개서(자유 양식) 제출 (선택) GitHub/기술 블로그/포트폴리오 링크 첨부 [합류 과정] 서류접수 → 1차 인터뷰 → 2차 인터뷰 → 처우논의 → 최종합격 전형 단계 중 필요 시, 사전 동의 후 레퍼런스 체크 진행 장애인 및 국가보훈대상자는 지원 시 관련법에 따라 우대함 [유의사항] 상기 영입 절차는 기본 프로세스이며, 회사의 사정에 따라 전형 절차가 추가 또는 변경될 수 있습니다. 세부 사항(지원 자격, 전형 방식 등)은 공고별로 상이하며, 지원자는 공고 내용을 충분히 확인할 책임이 있습니다. 지원서 및 제출 자료에 기재된 내용이 사실과 다르거나 허위로 판명될 경우, 전형 진행 중 또는 합격 이후라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다. 전형 진행 과정에서 필요 시, 지원자의 사전 동의를 받아 레퍼런스 체크 등 추가 검증 절차가 진행될 수 있습니다. 장애인 및 국가보훈대상자는 관련 법령에 따라 우대합니다. 원활한 채용 운영을 위해 동일 기간 내 복수 포지션에 대한 동시 지원은 제한될 수 있습니다. 본 채용은 수시채용으로 진행되며, 적합한 인재 채용 시 공고는 사전 고지 없이 조기 마감될 수 있습니다. 면접 방식 및 소요 시간은 전형 단계 및 상황에 따라 변경될 수 있습니다. 복지 및 혜택은 회사의 내부 규정, 취업규칙 및 개별 근로계약에 따라 변경 또는 제한될 수 있으며, 근로 형태에 따라 적용 범위가 상이할 수 있습니다. 문의: TA팀 recruit@nextsecurities.com

Demonstrated technical skills in the implementation, support and maintenance of enterprise infrastructure solutions in a large network environment. Demonstrated use of analytical and problem-solving skills to resolve technical issues that arise during the installation, upgrade or modification of complex IT infrastructure environments. Demonstrated communication and interpersonal skills including the ability to: Contribute toward creating a positive team environment, working collaboratively and actively sharing information and skills with others; Act professionally at all times while performing under pressure, managing your own workload and priorities to complete tasks and satisfy customer expectations. The Primary Accountabilities Of The Senior Systems Administrator Include Lead the second and third level support and maintenance of the departmental IT infrastructure. Participate in a team of technical specialists to undertake the development, configuration and implementation of new initiatives and solutions within a large ICT environment. Lead and undertake change management activities associated with infrastructure provisioning and maintenance. Research and provide advice in the continuous improvement of existing IT infrastructure and evaluation of new and emerging technologies. Provide feedback to clients, the Service Management and Application Management teams regarding the status of problems and service requests to ensure that agreed service levels and client service standards are achieved. Liaise effectively with clients, multi-disciplinary technology groups and external stakeholders on enterprise infrastructure matters. Maintain knowledge of current trends, industry and technology directions and product road maps for enterprise infrastructure technology. Occupational group IT & Telecommunications
